scholarships.title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) Office of International Affairs

eligibility: Current NYCU students, or incoming students applying with their admission application
Not have received scholarships or grants from the Taiwan government
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 for graduate students
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 for undergraduate students
For graduate students, match-funding from the college, department or advisor is compulsory
existing.eligibility_summary: International degree students at NYCU who have not received a scholarship or grant from the Taiwan government and maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 (graduate) or 3.0 (undergraduate). Monthly stipend and tuition award may be granted together or separately.
benefits: Maximum award duration of up to 5 years for PhD students
coverage: Monthly stipend funded by the OIA plus matching funds from the college, department or advisor
Tuition award, either a full tuition waiver or tuition and credit fees charged at the local student rate
requirements: Application uploaded in the NYCU scholarship application system by the closing date
Undergraduate recipients must enrol in at least 4 Mandarin courses and graduate recipients at least 2
Transcripts and tuition payment receipts submitted each semester before the deadline to keep the award for the following semester
documents: Application submitted through the NYCU scholarship application system
Further documents listed in the NYCU scholarship regulations
application_method: Current students apply and upload the required documents in the NYCU scholarship application system
Incoming students apply together with the admission application
existing.selection_notes: Awards are decided by the committees of the departments/colleges and the university; the Office of International Affairs cannot change the award.
existing.best_fit: Enrolled or incoming international degree students at NYCU with a GPA of 3.0 (undergraduate) or 3.5 (graduate) or above who hold no Taiwanese government scholarship.
existing.notes: The stipend amount is not published on this page and is described as flexibly adjusted according to budget; a separate NYCU Elite PhD Scholarship of NT$33,000 per month with tuition waiver for 2 years is listed on the same page.
existing.duration: Awards are generally valid for 1 year; maximum award duration is 4 years for undergraduates, 2 years for master's and 5 years for PhD students
existing.application_period: Twice yearly windows (January 15-March 15 and July 15-September 15) for current students; incoming students apply with the admission application
existing.deadline_display: Application Period for current NYCU students: Fall Semester January 15-March 15, Spring Semester July 15-September 15. Late application documents will not be accepted.
